context:
Goal: the two guard rules reach every repo that builds guards.
Problem (goal): nearly everything installs to every repo. Only .claude/ (this repo's own CLAUDE.md and rules/hooks.md), tests, records and the merge tool's config stay local, since they are about building claude-settings itself. PR #2852 would move the two guard rules into .claude/rules/, the local part, so your other repos would lose them.
Based on (read): install.sh on main installs the global CLAUDE.md, hooks, lint, skills, agents and settings.json into ~/.claude; .claude/rules holds only README.md and hooks.md.
Based on (notes): the two rules are "build a guard only against a mistake Claude has made" (47 words) and "trust a guard only after it goes red" (13 words); how many other repos have guards is unmeasured.
Departs from: your 11:59 CST Nov 12 pick a on items 536 and 538 — main keeps both in the global CLAUDE.md; option a leaves them there, b and c move them.

options.gain: Every repo keeps both rules; no gap.
options.how: Both rules stay in the global CLAUDE.md, as on main today.
options.label: Keep both rules global (Recommended)
options.lose: About 60 words stay in every session.

options.gain: About 60 words leave the global file.
options.how: Both rules move to .claude/rules in claude-settings, as your 11:59 CST Nov 12 pick said.
options.label: Move both to claude-settings rule files
options.lose: Every other repo loses both rules; a session building a check there never sees them.

options.gain: Reaches every repo and saves about 60 words per session.
options.how: A new skill, installed in every repo, holds both rules and loads when a guard is built or trusted.
options.label: Move both to a new skill
options.lose: A new skill to build, and a rule in a skill loads only if its description fits the task first (unmeasured).
